input.quote: 10.3 Assignment. This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 is a bare successors-and-assigns provision: it contains no consent standard in either direction. Our assignment freedom is not blocked and there is no HDI change-of-control termination or re-pricing right anywhere in the agreement (Section 4 termination rights at p0024/p0026 are notice/payment based), so the walk-away triggers are absent. However, the clause fails the fallback on a material term because the fallback still requires consent (not unreasonably withheld) for non-successor assignments; as drafted HDI may freely transfer this hosting arrangement — including access to Company data and the licensed Deerskin marks — to any third party, including a Company competitor. The minimal edit adds an express affiliate/M&A-successor carve-out for the Company, a reasonable-consent gate plus no-competitor limit on HDI assignments, and confirms a Company change of control triggers no HDI right.

proposal.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment freedom for the Company, a consent gate (and no-competitor limit) on HDI assignment, and confirm no HDI rights arise on a Company change of control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 currently binds successors and assigns but sets no consent standard, so HDI could transfer this hosting arrangement (including access to our data and Deerskin marks) to anyone, including a competitor. We have added our customary carve-out permitting the Company to assign to affiliates and M&A successors, a prior-written-consent requirement (not to be unreasonably withheld) on HDI assignments with no assignment to a Company competitor, and confirmation that a change of control of the Company gives HDI no termination or re-pricing right; if preferred, we can accept a mutual notice-plus-reasonable-consent formulation.

ops.oldText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
ops.newText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement. The Company may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without HDI's consent, to any affiliate of the Company or to any successor in connection with a merger, consolidation, reorganization, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or of the business to which this Agreement relates, and neither any such assignment nor any change of control of the Company shall give HDI any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement. HDI may not assign or otherwise transfer this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the Company's prior written consent (which shall not be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of the Company.
